description: Import explicit HTTP(S) URL strings into an owned, immutable old or new inventory. No crawl or page fetch. Use data.inventory.id with run_migration only when data.inventory.status is complete; a partial import lists its exclusions and needs corrected input and a new key. Up to 15,000 old / 20,000 new URLs and 16 MiB of URL text. Importing never authorizes a charge.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended change; retry an uncertain call with the identical input and key.

side.description: old = existing source pages; new = available destination pages.

urls.description: Absolute page URLs, not a sitemap URL. Path case, escapes and query strings are kept exactly.

name: import_inventory
title: Import a URL inventory
